role: Buffers streamed LLM text deltas and emits whole sentences (markdown stripped) for AVSpeechSynthesizer; finalize() flushes the tail.
types: SpokenTextChunker: final class — sentence-boundary buffer for TTS
state: mem:SpokenTextChunker.pendingBuffer (private(set) var, per instance; instance held at VoiceConversationController.textChunker)
toplevel: Static sentenceEnders set and the ordered markdownPatterns regex list (single * between letters and _ between word chars, *word* emphasis, list markers, numbered markers, ATX headers, [label](url)->label).

units.does: Appends delta to pendingBuffer and returns drainCompletedSentence() (a speakable chunk up to the last sentence boundary, or nil).
Trims the buffer, empties it, and returns the markdown-stripped remainder, or nil when the remainder or the stripped text is empty.
Finds the last index where isSentenceBoundary is true, cuts the buffer after it, keeps the rest buffered, and returns the trimmed+markdown-stripped head or nil if it is empty.

Decides whether the character at index ends a sentence: a newline always; '!', '?' and '.' never inside a markdown link or URL; '!' and '?' otherwise always; '.' only when not followed by a digit/letter and (if last char) not preceded by a digit.

branches.cond: inside a markdown link or URL
branches.effect: true: not a boundary ('.', '!' and '?' alike)
boundary only if next is neither number nor letter
true: boundary; false: boundary only if previous char is not a number (trailing '42.' waits)

units.does: True when the text before index ends in a token (from the last whitespace) containing '://' or starting 'www.', or is inside an unclosed '[label' or '[label](url' markdown link. Reads back only to the token start and the last '[', not splitting the whole buffer per candidate ender.

branches.effect: token starts after it; else at the buffer start

branches.cond: token contains :// or starts with www.

branches.effect: true: inside the link's url part

units.does: Removes '**', '__', backticks, then applies markdownPatterns in order (a single * between letters and _ between word chars removed — never next to a digit, so '5*3' survives —, *word* emphasis unwrapped, list/number/header markers removed, [label](url)->label).

branches.effect: each regex rewrite applied in order
